violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: quat sanitizer buckets used to sanitize prep counters contained 0ppm concentration. CFM stated the quat sanitizer dispenser was not working properly and may be dispensing the incorrect concentration of quat sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: EHS instructed CFM to free pour quat sanitizer and test sanitizer solution until quat sanitizer dispenser is repaired at the 3 vat sink. CFM stated Ecolab technician will be out to service the quat sanitizer dispenser this afternoon.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Box of avocados stored on the floor in the back kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated boxes of avocados to a shelf inside the walk in refrigerator.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: metal frame around the exterior of the ice machine in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CDI: CFM clean exterior metal frame around ice bin.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.'
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. CDI: EHS emailed CFM copy of employee health policy to review information with staff, sign, and maintain on file for future reference.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: uncooked sliced steak internal temperature at time of inspection was 46*.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM removed sliced steak from reach in cooler with improper ambient temperature at time of inspection, to the walk in cooler to cold hold until needed.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Hoshizaki flattop reach in cooler (front area near grill area) ambient temperature is 56F at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CDI: CFM removed all raw animal protein from reach in cooler and relocated to walk in cooler. CFM scheduled maintenance on the reach in cooler before using. CFM is checking the automated thermometer sensor system inside the unit. The sensor is supposed to to alert staff members when cold hold units ambient temperatures are elevated.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked diced chicken, cooked diced steak observed at 118-125F in to-go hot prep area.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC stated that the chicken and beef had been recently cut. PIC stated they would reheat the foods in a warmer to 165 for proper hot holding. EHS recommends keeping an empty container in the cutting station so cut foods may be transferred to a warmer container instead of a cool one and prevent heat loss.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Precooked brisket observed at 45F after 30 minutes inside of a non-working refrigeration unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC moved the food back to the walk-in to cool down.
